name: M-VAVE FM-1 (Melodee firmware)

midiIn.connector: USB class-compliant MIDI in/out, a 3.5 mm TRS MIDI in (input only) and BLE MIDI
midiIn.note: TRS type not stated. In this rig the unit sits on its own H4MIDI WC port (USB host through the hub) with a filter passing only its channel, because Melodee listens on a block of four channels.

clock.syncs: the sequencer: clock, Start, Continue, Stop and Song Position from the chosen input
clock.setting: GLO > GLOBAL > CLK = USB or TRS (the port Classic Tabby arrives on)

channelSetting: GLO > SYSTEM > ROUT = CH1-4 behind an H4MIDI WC port filter that passes only the unit's channel: channel 2 then plays the unit's track 2 (FM-1 A), channel 3 its track 3 (FM-1 B). There is no per-track input channel.

channel.note: GLO > SYSTEM > ROUT = CH1-4 / CH5-8 / CH9-12 / CH13-16 (four consecutive channels on tracks 1..4) or SEL (every channel plays the selected track); DRUM channel OFF / 1..16 (default 10); MIDI-track engines have an output channel only. USB class-compliant, TRS input, BLE MIDI. Wrong Room: behind an H4MIDI channel filter, ROUT = CH1-4.

programChange.note: Melodee 1.6.1 has no program change handler (0xCn is only forwarded to MIDI-only tracks for output); sounds are selected on the panel. The optional MIDI KNOBS profile turns the PRESETS encoder with CC 18 (GENERAL) or CC 76 (MINILAB), a knob emulation, not a PC. A program event targeted at this device does nothing.

setup: Load Melodee (web installer); GLO > SYSTEM > ROUT = CH1-4; the unit's H4MIDI WC port filtered to its channel (2 or 3), so only that channel reaches it and plays its track 2 or 3.
GLO > GLOBAL > CLK = USB (or TRS) so the unit follows Classic Tabby's clock, Start and Stop; its own clock out is silent then.
No program change: only CC events reach this device.
notes: Melodee 1.6.1 (2026-11-02) at research time; a modified Felucca. FM6 ROM voices: TINE EP, BRASS SECT, SOLID BASS, BELLS, MARIMBA, CLAVINET, DRAWBARS, STRINGS, GLASS PAD, SYNC LEAD, HARP, KALIMBA, FLUTE, STEEL DRUM, SAW BASS, TUBULAR (not selectable by MIDI).
1.6.1 adds clock out on USB and BLE with CLK = INT (not tried with gear by its author); irrelevant here, Classic Tabby is the master.
